in_marathi.name: Navee
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे New, Fresh, Young
in_marathi.long_meaning: Navee हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Navee is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Navas' meaning new or fresh. It is a feminine name that signifies youth and rejuvenation. In Hindu mythology, the goddess Saraswati is often referred to as 'Navadurga', meaning 'Nine Forms' or 'New Forms'. Navee embodies the spirit of new beginnings and fresh starts.
